title: Valid Card Type Codes
applicability: Applies to Segment 100 Prompt Code card context and to separate Table Load/Special Prompt Code families.

tableLoadResponseCodes.scope: Card acceptance and terminal feature configuration

businessRequirements.title: Financial Segment 100 Prompt Codes shall use one of the 36 Appendix E card types valid for financial transaction Prompt Codes.
A financial Prompt Code shall combine a valid Appendix G transaction type with a valid Appendix E financial card type.
Conoco internal code 89 shall not be used as the merchant Prompt Code; merchant transactions use card type 090.
Special three-character Prompt Codes shall be validated as special transaction artifacts and not accepted as standard financial Segment 100 Prompt Codes.
Table Load Response card type and terminal feature values shall be interpreted using the Appendix E Table Load Response code table, separately from the financial Prompt Code allowlist.
businessRequirements.coverageNote: The complete 56-value Appendix E Table Load allowlist is checked in DL1.CardType. This does not certify downstream terminal feature effects or production configuration.

testDataStatus: Appendix E Table Load allowlist has independent synthetic validator chains for all 56 listed values plus an unknown-code negative. Payloads test DL1.CardType membership only; feature effects, device behavior, production configuration, and AI artifact coverage remain outside this evidence. Nine of 11 special prompts have structured validator-harness chains; 900 and 997 remain review-blocked. Harness success does not equal business or converter certification.

Resolve the exact request/message-family and expected behavior contracts for special prompts 900 and 997.
Obtain Test Team/SME review and converter-level validation before claiming special-prompt operation certification.
Validate AI-generated artifacts across all 36 financial Prompt Code card types.
